chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch 484: Ji Ning’s Emotional Return & Meeting the Seven Empyrean Gods
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning returns to Brightheart Island after 18 years in the Realm of Annihilation. A heartwarming reunion with Qiuye and Northson, and a fateful meeting with the seven legendary Empyrean Gods.
og_description: After two decades in a death world, Ji Ning is back. Tissues required for the Qiuye reunion. Epic lore drops incoming with the seven Empyrean Gods.
twitter_title: He’s Back! Ji Ning Reunites with Family and Meets His Divine Army
twitter_description: Ji Ning escapes the void and returns home. Emotional goodbyes, a tearful reunion with Qiuye, and a first look at the seven Empyrean Gods who will follow him.

lore_anchors.definition: In Desolate Era, beings who have reached the pinnacle of Fiendgod Body Refining, equivalent to Celestial Immortals in lifespan but superior in physical combat. They are true gods born from Heaven and Earth.
The most powerful of Daoist Threelives' seven Empyrean Gods, one step away from becoming a True God/Daofather. Ji Ning's senior martial brother in the aquatic palace legacy.
An Empyrean God under Daoist Threelives, described as the 'most sinister' of the seven by his peers.
A straightforward, genuine Empyrean God serving under the legacy of Daoist Threelives.
An Empyrean God who is the human form of the Viperbird, a primordial divine beast of ultimate venom, born from the primordial Pangu's World.
An Empyrean God born from the sun's true fire in the primordial Pangu's World, twin brother of Empyrean God Dark Moon.
An Empyrean God born from the moon's true water in the primordial Pangu's World, twin brother of Empyrean God Scorching Sun.
The adopted son of Daoist Threelives, born as a Void Fiendgod, unable to learn the Starseizing Hand despite being the first follower.
A mysterious power that naturally manifests at a Sword Immortal's blade when they fully master the Grand Dao of the Sword and seek its deeper essence.
The legendary creator of the Starseizing Hand and the original master of the aquatic palace, whose seven Empyrean Gods now follow Ji Ning.
